question: Why was the reaction still incomplete at the time of the first spectrum?
answer: The reaction was still incomplete because it takes substantially longer to transport the sample tube into the magnetic field of the NMR spectrometer, which is why this effect was not observed with ALTADENA.
context: PHIP intensities in a spectrum recorded several seconds after the first spectrum. This indicates that the reaction was still incomplete at the time of the first spectrum. Since it takes substantially longer to transport the sample tube into the magnetic field of the NMR spectrometer, we did not observe this effect with ALTADENA.
